newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mixed, gas oil higher.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mixed, gas oil higher.

text.p: NWE oil products were mixed on Tuesday, with gas oil up and naphtha unchanged, traders said.
Gas oil firmed $4 on futures. Heating oil barge premiums firmed around 75 cents. Low sulphur cargoes eased around $1.
Prompt eurograde refinery material gasoline barges traded at $219 a tonne -- $2 below Monday's lowest deal.
Naphtha was quiet with levels unchanged as a prompt overhang pressured against any upward move.
Fuel oil eased. Barges fell to $110 fob ARA after an outage at Esso Netherlands' flexicoking unit created selling pressure.
